name: Cowork
description: Anthropic's multi-agent orchestration platform that enables background agents to work on tasks in parallel, with a web-based IDE environment for code editing, file management, and autonomous task execution using Claude models.

writing-chat.summary: Cowork provides a web-based chat interface integrated with a development environment, allowing users to converse with Claude while simultaneously viewing and editing code, files, and terminal output.

subFeatures.name: Integrated Chat and IDE
subFeatures.description: Side-by-side chat interface with a full development environment including file explorer, code editor, and terminal

subFeatures.name: Task-Oriented Conversations
subFeatures.description: Start conversations that become background tasks, with Claude autonomously working through multi-step coding objectives

subFeatures.name: Multi-Agent Chat
subFeatures.description: Launch multiple agents simultaneously, each handling a different task, with unified status tracking and result viewing

limitations: Web-only interface — no CLI access for Cowork-specific features
Requires Claude Pro or Team subscription
Agent conversations are task-scoped, not persistent across tasks
Currently in early access with evolving feature set

pricingTiers.details: Access to Cowork with background agents and limited concurrent tasks
Higher concurrency limits for parallel background agents
Maximum concurrency and usage limits for intensive workflows

versionHistory.changes: Multi-agent orchestration platform with background agents and web-based IDE

research.summary: Cowork agents can browse the web and search for information as part of their task execution, combining code-focused research with broader web research capabilities.

subFeatures.name: Web Browsing in Agent Tasks
subFeatures.description: Background agents can browse the web to research libraries, APIs, documentation, and best practices as part of coding tasks

subFeatures.name: Codebase Exploration
subFeatures.description: Agents navigate and search project files, understand architecture, and trace dependencies within the development environment

limitations: Web browsing limited to agent task context
Cannot access authenticated or paywalled content
Research results integrated into task output, not standalone research reports
Browser capabilities still maturing in agent environment

pricingTiers.details: Web research included as part of agent task execution

versionHistory.changes: Web browsing integrated into background agent capabilities

file-analysis.summary: Cowork provides a full file explorer and editor within its web-based IDE, allowing agents and users to read, analyze, and navigate project files with syntax highlighting and project structure awareness.

subFeatures.name: Web-Based File Explorer
subFeatures.description: Visual file tree navigator with the ability to browse, open, and read any file in the project workspace

subFeatures.name: Code Editor with Analysis
subFeatures.description: Syntax-highlighted code editor that agents use to read, understand, and modify files during task execution

subFeatures.name: Terminal Output Analysis
subFeatures.description: Integrated terminal where agents run commands and analyze build output, test results, and error messages

limitations: File access limited to the workspace environment
Large binary files may not be viewable in the web editor
Analysis capabilities depend on the underlying Claude model
No specialized tooling for database or image file analysis

pricingTiers.details: File analysis included in all Cowork-enabled plans

versionHistory.changes: Web-based IDE with file explorer, editor, and terminal

document-creation.summary: Cowork agents create documentation, configuration files, and text-based artifacts as part of their coding tasks, writing directly to the project workspace.

subFeatures.name: Agent-Generated Documentation
subFeatures.description: Background agents create README files, API docs, architecture documents, and configuration files as part of task completion

subFeatures.name: Multi-File Creation
subFeatures.description: Agents create multiple coordinated files in a single task, including source code and accompanying documentation

limitations: Limited to text-based file formats
No PDF, DOCX, or presentation generation
Document creation is part of coding tasks, not a standalone document tool
No collaborative real-time document editing between users

pricingTiers.details: Document creation included as part of agent task execution

versionHistory.changes: Multi-file creation and documentation generation in agent tasks

image-generation.summary: Cowork does not include image generation capabilities. It is focused on code and development tasks.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Cowork is a development-focused platform — image generation is not part of its feature set

limitations: No image generation capability
No integration with image generation APIs within the platform
Cannot create visual assets or graphics

prototyping.summary: Cowork excels at prototyping through its multi-agent architecture — users can describe what they want built and background agents scaffold entire projects, implement features, and run tests autonomously in a sandboxed environment.

subFeatures.name: Multi-Agent Project Scaffolding
subFeatures.description: Launch multiple agents to work on different parts of a project simultaneously — frontend, backend, tests, and configuration in parallel

subFeatures.name: Sandboxed Development Environment
subFeatures.description: Each agent works in an isolated environment with a full development setup including package managers, build tools, and test frameworks

subFeatures.name: Live Preview
subFeatures.description: View running applications and web previews within the Cowork environment during development

subFeatures.name: Iterative Refinement
subFeatures.description: Review agent output in the IDE, provide feedback, and launch follow-up tasks to refine the implementation

limitations: Sandbox environments may have limited package availability
Complex infrastructure setups (databases, message queues) may not be fully supported
Parallel agent coordination is managed by the platform, not user-directed
Preview capabilities limited to web-based applications

pricingTiers.details: Background agents with basic concurrency for prototyping
Higher concurrency for parallel prototyping agents

versionHistory.changes: Multi-agent prototyping with parallel task execution and web-based IDE

personalization.summary: Cowork supports project-level configuration and preferences that guide agent behavior, coding conventions, and task execution style within the workspace.

subFeatures.name: Project Configuration
subFeatures.description: Configure project-level instructions and conventions that all agents follow when working in the workspace

subFeatures.name: Task Customization
subFeatures.description: Provide specific instructions and constraints for individual agent tasks to tailor their approach

limitations: No persistent user profile across workspaces
Configuration options still evolving in early access
No per-user preference system within shared team workspaces
Limited to text-based instruction configuration

versionHistory.changes: Project-level configuration for agent behavior customization

persistent-context.summary: Cowork maintains persistent context through its workspace model — project files, agent task history, and configuration persist across sessions within a workspace.

subFeatures.name: Workspace Persistence
subFeatures.description: Project workspace with all files, configurations, and agent task history persists between sessions

subFeatures.name: Task History
subFeatures.description: Complete history of background agent tasks, their instructions, and results maintained within the workspace

subFeatures.name: Git Integration
subFeatures.description: Changes tracked through git within the workspace, providing full version history and the ability to review agent-made changes

limitations: Context limited to individual workspace scope
No cross-workspace context sharing
Agent memory does not persist between separate tasks
Workspace storage has size limits

pricingTiers.details: Workspace persistence included in all Cowork-enabled plans

versionHistory.changes: Persistent workspaces with task history and git integration

agents.summary: Cowork's defining feature is multi-agent orchestration — users launch background agents that work autonomously and in parallel on coding tasks, with the platform managing scheduling, isolation, and result aggregation.

subFeatures.name: Background Agents
subFeatures.description: Launch autonomous coding agents that work in the background on multi-step tasks while you focus on other work or review completed results

subFeatures.name: Parallel Task Execution
subFeatures.description: Run multiple agents simultaneously on different tasks — each agent gets its own isolated environment and works independently

subFeatures.name: Agent Status Tracking
subFeatures.description: Monitor the progress of all active background agents with real-time status updates, logs, and completion notifications

subFeatures.name: Autonomous Tool Use
subFeatures.description: Agents autonomously use file editing, terminal commands, web browsing, and other tools to complete their assigned tasks

limitations: Concurrent agent limits based on subscription tier
Agents cannot directly communicate with each other during execution
Complex inter-task dependencies must be manually managed by the user
Agent execution time has platform-imposed limits

pricingTiers.details: Higher agent concurrency and longer execution times
Maximum agent concurrency for intensive multi-agent workflows

versionHistory.changes: Multi-agent orchestration with background agents and parallel execution

connectors.summary: Cowork integrates with GitHub for repository management and version control, with the development environment supporting standard developer tool ecosystems.

subFeatures.name: GitHub Integration
subFeatures.description: Import repositories from GitHub, push changes, create branches, and manage pull requests from within the Cowork workspace

subFeatures.name: Development Tool Ecosystem
subFeatures.description: Workspace environments include standard development tools — package managers, build systems, and testing frameworks

limitations: GitHub is the primary version control integration at launch
No direct integration with project management tools (Jira, Linear)
No Slack or communication tool integration
External API integrations limited to what agents can access via web browsing

pricingTiers.details: GitHub integration and development tools included

versionHistory.changes: GitHub repository integration and standard development tool support

dictation.summary: Cowork does not include voice input or dictation capabilities. All interaction is through text-based chat and IDE interfaces.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Cowork is a web-based development platform with text input only — no voice or speech-to-text support

limitations: No voice input or dictation support
No audio processing capabilities
Web interface is text-input only
